answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a novel problem of zero-shot faithful planning with LLMs in TODs.
datasets: 4 domains, 13 intents and flows, 64 APIs, and 260 user queries
answer_1.outputs: plans consisting of a sequence of APIs to fulfil the user query while obeying the flow steps in F and preserving API dependencies in A

answer_2.quote: We define number of edits as the sum of additions and deletions of steps/APIs in the generated plan to make it contain the same steps/APIs as the gold plan.
